instructions: For each anonymized label set, choose the label that best matches the delivery behavior. One set is a historical reference vocabulary used only to compare comprehension; it is not proposed product terminology. Do not judge wording preference until every scenario is answered.

questions.scenario: Informational context can wait for the normal inbox cadence and must not interrupt active work.
The message should be shown before baseline context when the worker next becomes idle, but it must not steer or interrupt running work.
Time-sensitive input may request one graceful steering transition while work is running, without an immediate hard interruption.
An immediate safety or authority conflict requires the shortest fenced interruption path and operator-visible escalation on failure.
